newsitem.title: UK: RJB Mining boosted by press reports of deal. [CORRECTED 10:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RJB Mining boosted by press reports of deal. [CORRECTED 10:45 GMT]

text.p: Shares in British coal miner RJB Mining Plc rose on Monday amid press reports the group was due to announce a deal with electricity generator National Power.
The stock rose 34p, or 9.58 percent, to trade at 358p by 0945 GMT and were seen rising still further on announcement of the deal expected on Tuesday.
RJB shares touched a high of 625p on April 26 last year but have since dropped to current levels, which the Sunday Times said was due to market uneasiness over the threat of cheaper coal imports.

The Sunday Times newspaper said: "Shares in RJB Mining, Britain's largest coal producer, are expected to rise sharply tomorrow when it announces a breakthrough deal with National Power, one of the big electricity generators."
"National Power is set to join RJB and Texaco Inc, the American oil company, to develop Britain's first large-scale clean coal power station in West Yorkshire," the paper said.
The group are also due to release year-end profits on Tuesday.
